items.source: Spring Boot’s Parent POM, spring-boot-starter-parent, configures Failsafe’s <classesDirectory> to be ${project.build.outputDirectory}. Without this configuration, which causes Failsafe to use the compiled classes rather than the repackaged jar, Failsafe cannot load your application’s classes. If you are not using the parent POM, you should configure Failsafe in the same way, as shown in the following example:
items.translation: Spring Boot 的父 POM，`spring-boot-starter-parent`，将 Failsafe 的 `<classesDirectory>` 配置为 `${project.build.outputDirectory}`。如果没有此配置，Failsafe 会使用编译后的类而不是重新打包的 jar 文件，导致无法加载您的应用程序的类。如果您未使用父 POM，则应按照以下示例以相同方式配置 Failsafe：

items.source: Add maven resources to the classpath directly, this allows live in-place editing of resources. Duplicate resources are removed from target/classes to prevent them from appearing twice if ClassLoader.getResources() is called. Please consider adding spring-boot-devtools to your project instead as it provides this feature and many more.
items.translation: 直接将 Maven 资源添加到类路径中，这允许对资源进行实时原地编辑。重复的资源会从 target/classes` 中移除，以防止在调用 `ClassLoader.getResources()` 时出现两次。请考虑将 `spring-boot-devtools 添加到您的项目中，因为它提供了此功能以及更多功能。

items.source: While you may start your Spring Boot application very easily from your test (or test suite) itself, it may be desirable to handle that in the build itself. To make sure that the lifecycle of your Spring Boot application is properly managed around your integration tests, you can use the start and stop goals, as shown in the following example:
items.translation: 虽然您可以直接从测试（或测试套件）本身非常轻松地启动 Spring Boot 应用程序，但在构建过程中处理该操作可能更可取。为了确保 Spring Boot 应用程序的生命周期在集成测试周围得到正确管理，您可以使用 start 和 stop 目标，如下例所示：

items.source: You can now retrieve the test.server.port system property in any of your integration test to create a proper URL to the server.
items.translation: 您现在可以在任何集成测试中检索 test.server.port` 系统属性，以创建指向服务器的正确 `URL。

items.source: Such setup can now use the failsafe-plugin to run your integration tests as you would expect.
items.translation: 现在，这种配置可以使用failsafe-plugin来运行集成测试，就像您预期的那样。

items.source: You could also configure a more advanced setup to skip the integration tests when a specific property has been set, see the dedicated example.
items.translation: 您也可以配置更高级的设置，在设置特定属性时跳过集成测试，请参阅专用示例。

items.source: Arguments from the command line that should be passed to the application. Use spaces to separate multiple arguments and make sure to wrap multiple values between quotes. When specified, takes precedence over #arguments.
items.translation: 命令行中应传递给应用程序的参数。使用空格分隔多个参数，并确保将多个值用引号括起来。指定时优先于#arguments。

items.source: One nice feature of the Spring Boot test integration is that it can allocate a free port for the web application. When the start goal of the plugin is used, the Spring Boot application is started separately, making it difficult to pass the actual port to the integration test itself.
items.translation: Spring Boot 测试集成的一个优点是可以为 Web 应用程序分配一个空闲端口。当使用插件的 start 目标时，Spring Boot 应用程序会单独启动，这使得将实际端口传递给集成测试本身变得困难。

items.translation: jmxPort 属性允许自定义插件用于与 Spring Boot 应用程序通信的端口。

items.source: The skip property allows to skip the execution of the Spring Boot maven plugin altogether.
items.translation: skip 属性允许完全跳过 Spring Boot Maven 插件的执行。

items.source: Additional classpath elements that should be added to the classpath. An element can be a directory with classes and resources or a jar file.
items.translation: 应添加到类路径的额外类路径元素。一个元素可以是一个包含类和资源的目录，或一个 jar 文件。

items.source: Path to agent jars.
items.translation: 代理 JAR 文件的路径。

items.source: Arguments that should be passed to the application.
items.translation: 应传递给应用程序的参数。

items.source: Directory containing the classes and resource files that should be used to run the application.
items.translation: 包含用于运行应用程序的类和资源文件的目录。

items.source: List of Environment variables that should be associated with the forked process used to run the application.
items.translation: 与用于运行应用程序的派生进程关联的环境变量列表。

items.source: The JMX name of the automatically deployed MBean managing the lifecycle of the spring application.
items.translation: 自动部署的用于管理 Spring 应用程序生命周期的 MBean 的 JMX 名称。

items.source: The port to use to expose the platform MBeanServer.
items.translation: 用于暴露平台 MBeanServer 的端口。

items.source: JVM arguments that should be associated with the forked process used to run the application. On command line, make sure to wrap multiple values between quotes.
items.translation: 与用于运行应用程序的派生进程关联的 JVM 参数。在命令行中，请确保将多个值用引号括起来。

items.source: The name of the main class. If not specified the first compiled class found that contains a 'main' method will be used.
items.translation: 主类的名称。如果未指定，将使用找到的第一个包含'main'方法的编译类。

items.source: The maximum number of attempts to check if the spring application is ready. Combined with the "wait" argument, this gives a global timeout value (30 sec by default)
items.translation: 检查 Spring 应用程序是否就绪的最大尝试次数。与"wait"参数结合，可设置全局超时值（默认为 30 秒）。

items.source: Flag to say that the agent requires -noverify.
items.translation: 标记表示代理需要 `-noverify`。

items.source: The spring profiles to activate. Convenience shortcut of specifying the 'spring.profiles.active' argument. On command line use commas to separate multiple profiles.
items.translation: 要激活的 Spring 配置文件。这是指定 `spring.profiles.active` 参数的便捷快捷方式。在命令行中，使用逗号分隔多个配置文件。

items.source: List of JVM system properties to pass to the process.
items.translation: 传递给进程的 JVM 系统属性列表。

items.source: Flag to include the test classpath when running.
items.translation: 运行时的标志，用于包含测试类路径。

items.source: The number of milliseconds to wait between each attempt to check if the spring application is ready.
items.translation: 检查 Spring 应用程序是否就绪时，每次尝试之间的等待毫秒数。

items.source: Current working directory to use for the application. If not specified, basedir will be used.
items.translation: 用于应用程序的当前工作目录。如果未指定，将使用 basedir。

items.source: The JMX name of the automatically deployed MBean managing the lifecycle of the application.
items.translation: 自动部署的用于管理应用程序生命周期的 MBean 的 JMX 名称。

items.source: The port to use to look up the platform MBeanServer.
items.translation: 用于查找平台 MBeanServer 的端口。

items.source: Collection of artifact definitions to exclude. The Exclude element defines mandatory groupId and artifactId components and an optional classifier component. When configured as a property, values should be comma-separated with colon-separated components: groupId:artifactId,groupId:artifactId:classifier
items.translation: 要排除的构件定义集合。Exclude 元素定义了必需的 groupId 和 artifactId 组件以及可选的 classifier 组件。当配置为属性时，值应以逗号分隔，组件之间以冒号分隔：groupId:artifactId,groupId:artifactId:classifier

items.source: Collection of artifact definitions to include. The Include element defines mandatory groupId and artifactId components and an optional classifier component. When configured as a property, values should be comma-separated with colon-separated components: groupId:artifactId,groupId:artifactId:classifier
items.translation: 要包含的制品定义集合。Include 元素定义了必需的 groupId 和 artifactId 组件以及可选的 classifier 组件。当配置为属性时，值应以逗号分隔，组件之间以冒号分隔：groupId:artifactId,groupId:artifactId:classifier

items.source: Start a spring application. Contrary to the run goal, this does not block and allows other goals to operate on the application. This goal is typically used in integration test scenario where the application is started before a test suite and stopped after.
items.translation: 启动 Spring 应用程序。与 run 目标不同，此操作不会阻塞并允许其他目标对该应用程序进行操作。此目标通常用于集成测试场景，在该场景中，在测试套件运行前启动应用程序，并在之后停止。

items.source: Comma separated list of groupId names to exclude (exact match).
items.translation: 要排除的 groupId 名称逗号分隔列表（精确匹配）。

items.source: Stop an application that has been started by the "start" goal. Typically invoked once a test suite has completed.
items.translation: 停止通过"start"目标启动的应用程序。通常在测试套件完成后调用一次。
